assumptions.statement: n is a positive integer; P reverses 2n coordinates; S_ii=(-1)^(i+1); E is its left n-by-n diagonal; Be/Bo have (e_i +/- e_mirror)/sqrt(2) columns. K is arbitrary real or complex. Commutation and symmetry are NOT assumed for sector-exchange identities.
Finite positive block lengths sum to L>0; real densities obey 0<m<=rho<=M<infinity; left Dirichlet shooting y(0)=0,y_prime(0)=1; right DD or DN; frequency is positive and mode labels are one-based.
Real weighted string -u_second=lambda*rho*u on (0,1), Dirichlet endpoints, continuity of u and u_prime at density interfaces, no point masses or additional mass constraint.
R is fixed with 1<R<infinity; all five block widths are strictly positive. Neither R=1 nor infinite-R limits are covered by K formulas.
SUP heights (1,R,1,R,1), sigma=+1; INF heights (R,1,R,1,R), sigma=-1. eta=R-1; s_i=rho_right-rho_left=sigma*eta*(-1)^(i+1).

Full real eigenfunctions have integral_0^1 rho*u_k*u_l=delta_kl and u_k_prime(0)>0. Half eigenfunctions are sqrt(2) times the matching restrictions; half Green kernels use half weighted unit normalization.
x4=1-x1 and x3=1-x2, with 0<x1<x2<1/2. This is a hypothesis of the Green and sector formulas, not a conclusion about all stationary points.
a=lambda2, b=lambda3, Delta=b-a, f=a*u2^2-b*u3^2; f vanishes at all four interfaces. Stationarity is exact, not merely a numerical residual tolerance.
J_ij=partial(F_i)/partial(x_j), F_i=f(x_i)/b; all four interfaces vary independently before evaluation at a symmetric band point. K=diag(1/s)*J; Kp=S*K*S.
Resolvent denominators are eigenvalue minus spectral parameter. Reduced full kernels remove full modes 2 or 3; reduced half kernels remove DD1 or DN2. Delta sources carry no extra rho(source) factor.
H/E tail formulas exclude full adjacent modes 2,3; the same exact mode set is used in every finite truncation. Infinite pointwise sums are justified by energy evaluation estimates.
A is real symmetric and alpha>0. A-alpha*z*z^T is positive definite iff A is positive definite and alpha*z^T*A_inverse*z<1. Applying this requires exact object/sector identification.

derived_not_assumed: Positive coordinate scaling fixes both integer and half-integer multiples of pi.
Every DD/DN target has a unique positive frequency with the stated mode identity and comparison bracket.
lambda_(2j-1)=mu_j^N and lambda_(2j)=mu_j^D at every j for symmetric density.
For n=2 symmetric exact band points, u2 is nonzero at interfaces, W<0, epsilon_i=(-1)^(i+1), and d_i has sign sigma.
The normalized eigenfunction shape derivative has a +s_i*u_i^2/2 component along the eigenfunction.
K commutes with P at the symmetric stationary point, while general sector exchange does not require commutation.
Cross-half Green formula gives KpOdd=E*Ke*E; raw Ko needs own-pole reduced kernels plus rank one.
Historical H/E assemblies are Kp sectors; raw totals and each component require the same swap and E congruence.
The third-card negative-rank positive-definiteness criterion is for KpOdd, equivalently raw Ke.
The historical H_o-E_o lower bound is not a general sufficient condition for diag(d)+H_o+E_o positive definite; the manuscript gives a matrix-only counterexample.
